# genesyscloud_analytics_dataretention_settings (Data Source)

<!-- This document is automatically generated. Do not edit manually. Make changes to the schema, examples, or apis.md files in examples/data-sources/ and run 'make docs' to regenerate. -->

Data source for the Genesys Cloud Analytics Maximum Interaction Data Retention Time. Retrieves the organization's analytics data retention setting. This is a singleton, so no arguments are required to identify it.

## API Usage

The following Genesys Cloud APIs are used by this data source. Ensure your OAuth Client has been granted the necessary scopes and permissions to perform these operations:

* [GET /api/v2/analytics/dataretention/settings](https://developer.genesys.cloud/devapps/api-explorer#get-api-v2-analytics-dataretention-settings)

## Permissions and Scopes

The following permissions are required to use this resource:

* `analytics:dataRetention:view`

The following OAuth scopes are required to use this resource:

* `analytics`
* `analytics:readonly`


## Example Usage

```terraform
data "genesyscloud_analytics_dataretention_settings" "analytics_dataretention_settings" {
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `retention_days` (Number) The maximum number of days that interaction data and recordings are retained for the organization.
